name: Team Charmander: Thunderous Tempest & Glacial Execution
archetype: 4x Electric and 4x Ice precision OHKOs, Sleep status pacification, and Fighting wallbreaking.
gym_duel_rationale: Clair's 5v5 dragon duel prompts the player to select 5 active Pokémon from the party: Alakazam/Raichu leads with blazing speed to execute Feraligatr/Gyarados with an effortless 4x super-effective STAB Thunderbolt OHKO; Lapras rotates into the duel core to wall incoming dragon attacks and fire devastating 4x STAB Ice Beams to obliterate Donphan/Dragonair and ace Garchomp/Aerodactyl; Charizard/Venusaur levels to Cap 68 to command the frontline, putting setup sweepers to sleep with Sleep Powder while incinerating Glaceon/Kingdra and Ariados/Charizard with STAB Flamethrower; Primeape/Sandslash crushes Glaceon/Kingdra with STAB Close Combat and lands 4x super-effective Rock coverage on Ariados/Charizard; and Gyarados/Nidoking applies Intimidate to neuter physical offensive threats.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST hybrid anchor elevated to Cap 68. Sleep Powder shuts down Dragon Dance setup. STAB Flamethrower incinerates Glaceon/Kingdra and Ariados/Charizard.
500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. STAB Thunderbolt lands an effortless 4x super-effective OHKO on lead Feraligatr/Gyarados.

roster.status: Active in Party (Rotated into Duel Core)
roster.progression_notes: 535 BST Water/Ice wall elevated to Lv. 67. STAB Ice Beam lands devastating 4x super-effective blows to vaporize Donphan/Dragonair and ace Garchomp/Aerodactyl.
477 BST physical wallbreaker. STAB Close Combat shatters Glaceon/Kingdra with super-effective force.
522 BST physical pivot. Intimidate neutralizes physical attack on entry, blunting Garchomp/Aerodactyl's Dragon Dance assault.

roster.progression_notes: Colossal 160 HP tank. Benched during the 5v5 duel in favor of 4x offensive counter-picks, but serves as route travel sponge.

Levitate Ground immunity and high physical Defense with Sludge Bomb against physical attackers.
